title: When the Judge Should Not Decide: Evidence-Locked, Non-Compensatory Selection Bounds LLM-Judge Failure in Reasoning Pipelines
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.07813v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: An LLM judge deployed inside a reasoning pipeline does not merely measure quality, it decides which answer ships. We show that the cost of that decision depends less on judge accuracy than on the decision rule the judge is embedded in. On frozen candidate pools from four GRPO policies, an unconstrained scalar DeepSeek-R1-7B judge buys almost nothing over answer-level majority vote (+1.0 pp on 500 GSM8K questions, +0.34 EM on 300 HotpotQA questions), and on a frozen-rule 30-question confirmation split it is 10 points worse than majority, a judge that destroys accuracy while scoring candidates confidently. We then subordinate the same judge to Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair (EL-DGR), a task-adaptive non-compensatory rule under which a judge preference may override evidence-supported consensus only with an extractive evidence certificate, and a repair only when neither alternative is certified and the repair is. reason_zh: 揭示LLM裁判在推理管线中的决策规则比准确性更重要，反直觉洞察深刻。
summary_zh: 本文研究LLM裁判在推理管线中的作用，指出其决策规则比准确性更关键。在四个GRPO策略的冻结候选池上，无约束的标量DeepSeek-R1-7B裁判几乎无增益，而采用证据锁定、非补偿性选择（如强制要求证据支持）的规则能显著提升最终答案质量。作者提出“当裁判不应决定”的场景，为设计可靠的推理管线提供了新视角。
title_zh: 当裁判不应决定：证据锁定、非补偿性选择限制推理管线中的LLM裁判失败

title: An AI Scientist that Doesn't Drift: Taste, Structure, and Falsifiable Findings in a Quadruped Navigation Research Loop
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.07542v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Autonomous research loops driven by large language models can run machine-learning experiments at scale but tend to drift toward local refinements of whichever metric they optimise rather than testing the hypotheses that motivate the experiments. We address this structurally and present an AI Scientist for studying generalisation in quadruped robot navigation policies in simulation. Building on the autoresearch paradigm of Karpathy, our loop adds three components: an immutable experiment card that pairs each iteration's prediction with its outcome under a fixed schema, so a falsified hypothesis cannot be retconned; specialised subagents restricted to mechanical roles; and kkanbu, a preference oracle that holds the user's research taste as a typed knowledge graph and is the only component permitted to make subjective judgements. To isolate the oracle we run the identical loop twice across eleven research streams, with and without kkanbu.
reason_zh: 提出结构化的AI科学家循环，防止漂移，对自动化科研有重要价值。
summary_zh: 由LLM驱动的自主研究循环可以大规模运行机器学习实验，但往往漂移向优化指标的局部改进，而非测试激励实验的假设。本文从结构上解决此问题，提出一个用于研究四足机器人泛化的AI科学家。通过引入品味和结构约束，确保研究过程产生可证伪的发现，避免漂移。
title_zh: 不漂移的AI科学家：四足导航研究循环中的品味、结构与可证伪发现

title: CMU-Drive and V2V-VLA: Cooperative Multi-agent Unified Driving with Reasoning Benchmark and Vehicle-to-Vehicle Vision-Language-Action Models
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.07621v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved impressive performance for end-to-end autonomous driving, yet existing approaches are primarily designed for an individual single autonomous driving agent with limited support for cooperative perception, reasoning, and planning. We further propose Vehicle-to-Vehicle Vision-Language-Action (V2V-VLA), a cooperative VLA model that integrates cooperative driving into a single forward pass by jointly generating driving actions, future waypoints, language reasoning, and communication policies. reason_zh: 提出协同多智能体驾驶框架和V2V-VLA模型，推动自动驾驶合作感知与规划。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在端到端自动驾驶中表现出色，但现有方法主要针对单个自动驾驶代理，对协同感知、推理和规划支持有限。本文提出协同多智能体统一驾驶框架，并引入V2V-VLA模型，支持车辆间通信，实现合作驾驶。同时提供推理基准，评估协同驾驶能力。

title: Who Built This Model? Tracing LLM Lineage via Spectral Fingerprints in Weight Space
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.07786v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly developed through complex, multi-stage pipelines, leading to intricate lineage relationships that reflect model origin, ownership, and evolution. Understanding these relationships is important for model provenance, governance, and supply-chain integrity. In this work, we investigate the notion of LLM "biometrics" (analogous to human biometrics) to ask whether LLMs exhibit intrinsic fingerprints in weight space alone, without access to input data, that reveal their origin and lineage. We formulate this as a lineage discrimination problem, distinguishing among independent-origin, same-series, and shared-base models. reason_zh: 通过权重谱指纹追踪LLM血统，为模型溯源和治理提供新方法，创新性强。
summary_zh: 本文研究开放权重LLM的谱系追踪问题。由于模型常经过多阶段复杂流水线开发，其来源和演化关系难以追溯。作者提出利用权重空间的谱指纹（spectral fingerprints）来识别模型的血统，通过分析权重矩阵的谱特征，可以判断模型是否衍生自某个基础模型，以及经过哪些微调或合并操作。该方法对模型溯源、知识产权保护和供应链安全具有重要意义。
title_zh: 谁构建了这个模型？通过权重空间谱指纹追踪LLM血统

title: When Is Benchmark Contamination Detectable? Information Limits and Power-Calibrated Audits
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.07914v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Behavioral contamination detectors can return "no evidence" either because a benchmark is clean or because the audit has little power. We formalize this distinction for a benchmark in which an unknown fraction alpha of items was seen during training. With matched clean and seen controls, the behavioral channel is the sparse mixture Q_alpha = (1 - alpha) P_0 + alpha P_1, and an exact second-moment argument shows that detectability is governed by alpha * rho * sqrt(m), where rho^2 = chi^2(P_1 || P_0) measures behavioral separability. Any scalar detector reduces to its efficacy, ef = |E_1 f - E_0 f| / sqrt(Var_0(f)) <= rho, which can be estimated from controls before the audit is run. A separate sample-split certificate lower-bounds alpha distribution-free, without requiring an orientation assumption. Our empirical finding is two-sided. reason_zh: 首次从信息论角度分析基准污染检测的极限，为审计方法提供理论指导，极具启发性。
summary_zh: 本文研究基准污染检测的统计极限。作者形式化了行为检测器无法区分“干净”与“低功效”的情况，并推导出检测污染所需的最小样本量。通过匹配干净和污染样本，提出功效校准的审计方法，为评估基准污染提供了理论框架和实用工具。
title_zh: 何时可检测基准污染？信息极限与功效校准审计

title: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.08020v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Test-time compute scaling is a primary driver of performance in large reasoning models (LRMs), but extreme inefficiency bounds current approaches, shifting the critical question from \emph{how much} compute to spend, to \emph{where} to allocate it. We formalize test-time reasoning as a constrained compute allocation problem over partial trajectories. Under a fixed hardware budget, existing paradigms fail to actively allocate the compute to the most promising partial progress: traditional parallel sampling treats traces independently and induces severe memory bottlenecks, while subtractive pruning starves hardware and fails to actively and sufficiently shift the output distribution. To overcome this dichotomy, we introduce Gambit, an inference algorithm that executes \emph{thought-level beam search}. By periodically pruning unpromising trajectories and immediately branching from high-quality prefixes, Gambit dynamically concentrates compu
reason_zh: 将测试时计算分配形式化为约束优化问题，提出思想级束搜索，提升推理效率，对推理模型有重要影响。
summary_zh: 本文研究大型推理模型的测试时计算扩展问题，指出当前方法效率低下。作者将推理形式化为部分轨迹上的约束计算分配问题，提出思想级束搜索方法，在给定计算预算下优化分配。实验显示在多个推理任务上以更少计算达到更高准确率，为推理模型效率提升提供新方向。
title_zh: 思想级束搜索用于推理

# vLLM v0.27.0 Release Notes

## Highlights

This release features 561 commits from 242 contributors (64 new)!

* **Kimi K3 support** with a full stack landing in one release: core model files and kernels (#50089, #50000), Python (#50093) and Rust (#50104) frontends, AttnRes kernels (#50090), DeepGEMM support (#50458), compressed-tensors quantized checkpoints (#50500), DSpark AR fusion (#50242), and an option to shard the shared expert instead of replicating it (#50656).

* **PyTorch 2.13.0 upgrade** along with torchvision 0.28.0 and Triton 3.7.1 (#48155) — this is a breaking environment change; XPU (#48677) and CPU (#50412) followed to torch 2.13 as well.
* **FlashAttention 4 integration deepens on SM100**: FP8 KV cache support (#42569)

title: TeXFix-Bench: An Empirically Grounded Multi-Format Benchmark for LLM-Based Document Source Repair
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.07617v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Scientific and technical writing depends on markup sources that must compile: LaTeX, Typst, and Markdown pipelines fail on missing delimiters, mismatched environments, broken imports, or package conflicts. Existing document-repair evaluations inject faults with ad-hoc edits that lack an empirical fault model. We present TeXFix-Bench, a multi-format benchmark for LLM-based full-source document repair grounded in a mined fault taxonomy. A Grounded-Theory study of localized hard-crash LaTeX faults from TeX Stack Exchange, GitHub commits, and package documentation (168 verified faults, dual open coding at $\kappa$=0.34) yields an 18-category taxonomy instantiated as DocMut: 48 AST-aware operators across three formats. A three-model cross-benchmark shows DocMut faults are 5.6-9.2 pp harder to repair than pattern-based mutations on the same seeds, and a real-error case study (88 mined human crashes, 67.0% repair success) brackets both syntheti
reason_zh: 基于经验故障模型的多格式文档修复基准，对LLM实际应用有实用价值。
summary_zh: 科学和技术写作依赖必须编译的标记源：LaTeX、Typst和Markdown管道因缺少分隔符、环境不匹配、导入损坏或包冲突而失败。现有文档修复评估使用临时编辑注入故障，缺乏经验故障模型。本文提出TeXFix-Bench，一个多格式基准，基于经验故障模型评估LLM的文档源修复能力。
title_zh: TeXFix-Bench：基于经验的多格式LLM文档源修复基准

title: CliniCARE-Bench: Clinical Calibrated Audit of Medical Reasoning in EHR
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.07796v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models perform strongly on medical knowledge benchmarks, but reliable clinical deployment requires agents to conduct defensible investigations over heterogeneous, longitudinal records: determining what evidence is needed, retrieving and reconciling structured and free-text data, grounding conclusions in verifiable evidence, and deferring cases that cannot be resolved reliably. We introduce CliniCARE-Bench (Clinical Calibrated Audit of Medical Reasoning in EHR), a benchmark for retrospective clinical audit: 25 clinician-validated scenarios instantiated as 750 patient-specific cases over real-patient-derived MIMIC-IV data. Systems investigate each case through a governed, logged tool environment for record retrieval, computation, and policy access, and return one of four verdicts---Yes, No, Indeterminate: Lack of Data, or Indeterminate: Medically Ambiguous---the last two separating missing evidence from residual medical ambi
reason_zh: 提出临床校准的EHR推理基准，强调可辩护的医学决策，对医疗AI落地有指导意义。
summary_zh: 本文指出LLM在医学知识基准上表现优异，但临床部署需要智能体对异构、纵向的电子健康记录（EHR）进行可辩护的调查：确定所需证据、检索和协调结构化与自由文本数据、基于可验证证据得出结论，并在不确定时延迟判断。为此，作者提出CliniCARE-Bench，一个临床校准的基准，用于评估LLM在EHR上的推理能力，强调证据锁定和校准的重要性。
title_zh: CliniCARE-Bench：EHR中临床校准的医学推理审计

title: Nanyang Technological University, Peking University, and BAAI Release Omega-0 — A Whole-Body Action Model That Hits 81.8 Percent Success on Real Home Tasks
raw_text: Researchers from Nanyang Technological University, Peking University, HKUST (GZ), and Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI) released Omega-0, a latent-prediction world action model that lets a humanoid robot walk, look, and work at the same time. Single-model success on 11 real home tasks reached 81.8 percent, ahead of pi-0.5, EgoVLA, GR00T-N1.7, and psi-0.
reason_zh: Omega-0全身动作模型在真实任务中成功率领先，具研究价值。
summary_zh: 南洋理工大学、北京大学、香港科技大学（广州）和北京智源人工智能研究院的研究人员发布了Omega-0，一种潜在预测世界动作模型，使机器人能同时行走、观察和工作。在11项真实家庭任务中，单模型成功率达81.8%，优于pi-0.5、EgoVLA、GR00T-N1.7和psi-0。该研究展示了全身控制的新方法。
title_zh: 南洋理工、北大、智源发布Omega-0全身动作模型，真实家庭任务成功率81.8%

title: 扎克伯格罕见发万字长文：超级智能不能被少数人垄断，必须属于每一个人

title: A sandbox without a network boundary is only half a sandbox
raw_text:
Running untrusted code safely requires more than separating it from the host. You also have to control what that code can reach.

This matters more as AI agents gain the ability to read files, execute commands, install packages, and generate programs of their own. A microVM can prevent that code from accessing the host or another workload. By itself, it cannot stop the code from exfiltrating data, probing internal services, attacking systems elsewhere on the internet, or using credentials available inside the environment.

Isolation without egress control contains the process, not its consequences.

A complete sandbox therefore needs both compute isolation and control over the authority available through its network: where code can connect, which credentials it can use, and how those permissions change throughout the workload’s lifecycle. These controls are part of the security boundary, not protections to bolt on later.

A sandbox has more than one boundary

title: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model
raw_text: OpenAI is expanding its AI cybersecurity defense program Daybreak, and rolling out a new cyber-trained AI model with it.
reason_zh: OpenAI扩展网络安全防御计划Daybreak并推出新网络模型，应对AI攻击，对安全领域从业者有重要参考价值。
summary_zh: OpenAI宣布扩大其AI网络安全防御计划Daybreak，并推出一个新的经过网络训练的AI模型。该模型旨在帮助组织防御日益增长的AI主导攻击。随着AI攻击手段的多样化，OpenAI此举旨在提供更强大的防御工具。新模型可能具备检测和响应网络威胁的能力，但具体细节尚未披露。这一举措反映了AI在网络安全领域的双向应用。
